messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
The ATP (men’s) and WTA (women’s) rankings are maintained separately, so the “top‑ranked” player depends on which tour you’re looking at:

| Tour | Current No. 1 (as of the latest rankings released in September 2026) |
|------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ATP  | **Novak Djokovic** – he has reclaimed the world No. 1 spot after a strong run in the 2026 season. |
| WTA  | **Iga Świątek** – she remains the top‑seeded player on the women’s tour, having defended her title at the 2026 French Open. |

These rankings are updated weekly, so the exact player can shift if a new ranking list is released. If you need the most up‑to‑date ranking for a specific week, let me know the date and I can look it up.
